C:P2.3.text: Park Hotels & Resorts Inc. is one of the largest lodging real estate investment trusts (REIT) comprised of a geographically diverse portfolio of hotels and resorts with significant underlying real estate value. Our portfolio consists of 29 premium-branded hotels and resorts with approximately 21,000 rooms located in prime U.S. markets with high barriers to entry. Over 90% of our portfolio is in the luxury or upper upscale segment; Approximately 80% of our portfolio is located in the central business districts ...
